shortDesc: Choice filling planner and rank analysis tool for JoSAA engineering admissions.
fullDesc:
An automated choice-filling helper and cutoff analysis tool designed for students navigating the JoSAA (Joint Seat Allocation Authority) admission rounds in India.

Core Idea:
The project helps applicants optimize their seat allocation probability by parsing previous years' opening and closing rank matrices. It generates a ranked list of choice preferences based on student ranks, categories, and branch priorities, ensuring candidates do not miss out due to manual error.
highlights: Algorithmic choice order generator using previous admission cutoffs
Fast query processing for rank-range filtering and branch priorities
Clean web interface with interactive filters
